evidence.title: Press Release: Sanofi provides update on tolebrutinib regulatory submission in non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (Paris, December 24, 2025)
evidence.text: Verbatim extracts from the source: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a complete response letter (CRL)

evidence.title: Fierce Pharma, 6 January 2026: FDA cites severe liver injury risk, unclear benefit behind Sanofi's MS drug rejection
evidence.text: Verbatim extracts from the source: the risk of severe drug-induced liver injury (DILI) recorded in tolebrutinib trials can't be adequately managed [...] a favorable benefit-risk profile could not be established for any patient subpopulation

meta.note: second quote is the article's quotation of the FDA complete response letter

claims.claim: The US FDA issued a complete response letter for Sanofi's tolebrutinib marketing application in non-relapsing secondary progressive MS (24 December 2025).
claims.quote: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a complete response letter (CRL)

claims.claim: According to the FDA, the risk of severe drug-induced liver injury seen in tolebrutinib trials cannot be adequately managed.
claims.quote: the risk of severe drug-induced liver injury (DILI) recorded in tolebrutinib trials can't be adequately managed

claims.claim: The FDA's complete response letter states that a favorable benefit-risk profile for tolebrutinib could not be established for any patient subpopulation.
claims.quote: a favorable benefit-risk profile could not be established for any patient subpopulation
